title: Quiet-hours offer without saying what quiet hours are
origin: Yanni live, 2026-10-27 (issue #36); the empty reply and "already set up" plan are #37
testerLines: I think I should be done eating for the day around 11pm because usually I like to have a late night snack every day
whatWentWrong: ZOH replied "Want me to move quiet hours to 11:30 pm to 9 am so my reminders reach you at 11?" The tester had never heard of quiet hours. Then (#37), after saving the new quiet hours and the plan in a reply that sent nothing, the retry said "Your plan is already set up, so what do you think of it?" when they had never seen it.
shouldHaveHappened: Before the plan, ZOH explains in plain words that by default it doesn't text between 10 pm and 9 am so it won't wake or bother them, then offers once to move that window so it can still reach them around 11; one question in that text. After the yes, it saves the new quiet hours and carries on: it asks anything the plan still needs (one question), and as soon as it has everything it shows the plan itself in that text as a • list (day 1's step, the usual schedule, the log screenshot as proof) ending with one question. It never says the plan is already set up or shown above, never asks what they think of a plan they haven't seen, and doesn't ask about quiet hours again.

answers.what: hit a protein target, about 160 g a day

history.text: Perfect. What time are you usually done eating for the day? That's when you'll send me your log.
